one_line: Crowned at Thanesar, Harsha Vardhana who rose from crisis to dominate Kannauj and the middle Ganga plain.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, athletic and tall with a lean, disciplined build
appearance.face: oval face with sharp cheekbones, medium wheatish complexion, straight nose, expressive dark brown eyes with slightly thick brows, a small tilak mark on the forehead, default expression calm but alert with a hint of compassionate resolve
appearance.hair: thick dark brown-black hair gathered into a high topknot secured with a slim gold band, short neat side fringe above the brow, no facial hair, wearing a simple narrow golden circlet resting low on the forehead
appearance.costume: early 7th-century north Indian royal attire: a knee-length, light-cream silk angarkha-style wrap tunic with long fitted sleeves and a subtle woven border in maroon and gold; over this a sleeveless, slightly shorter maroon silk over-tunic with side slits and narrow gold edging; a broad gold-embroidered cloth belt (patka) in deep maroon wraps around his waist with the knotted end hanging to his left; lower garment is a tightly wrapped off-white cotton dhoti tied at the waist and brought to mid-calf with clean pleats in front; feet in brown leather strapped sandals; jewellery kept dignified and restrained—single medium-width gold armlet on the right upper arm, a thin gold bangle on each wrist, a simple gold chain with a small round pendant at the neck, and small round gold ear-studs; a light, pale-cream cotton shawl with maroon border is draped from his left shoulder across the torso and tucked at the belt, ready to be used as a practical cloak in travel scenes
appearance.signature: a long, straight early-medieval Indian steel sword (khadga-like) with a slightly flared tip, plain cross-guard and simple rounded pommel, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings and worn suspended from the belt on his left hip

ref_desc: Harsha Vardhana is a tall, athletic young man with a wheatish oval face, dark eyes, a small tilak, and dark hair in a high topknot with a slim gold circlet, wearing cream and maroon layered tunics over an off-white dhoti with a maroon belt, minimal gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a simple long straight khadga in a brown leather scabbard; main colours are cream, maroon, gold, off-white and brown.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Harsha Vardhana as a dignified early 7th-century north Indian king: a tall, athletic young man with a wheatish oval face, straight nose, intense dark brown eyes, slightly thick brows, and a small tilak on his forehead, his thick dark hair tied into a high topknot secured with a slim gold band and a narrow gold circlet resting low on his brow, clean-shaven; he wears a light-cream long-sleeved silk angarkha-style wrap tunic to the knee with subtle maroon-and-gold woven borders, over which sits a sleeveless slightly shorter maroon silk over-tunic with narrow gold edging and side slits, belted at the waist with a broad maroon patka cloth belt richly embroidered with gold and knotted at his left with the end hanging; his lower garment is a neatly pleated off-white cotton dhoti wrapped to mid-calf, and on his feet are brown leather strapped sandals; adorn him with restrained royal jewellery—a single medium-width gold armlet on his right upper arm, thin gold bangles on both wrists, a simple gold chain with a small round pendant, and small round gold ear-studs—and add a pale-cream cotton shawl with maroon border draped from his left shoulder across his chest and tucked into the belt; at his left hip hangs his signature weapon, a long straight Indian steel khadga-like sword with a slightly flared tip, plain cross-guard and rounded pommel, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings; show multiple angles to emphasise the consistent cream, maroon, gold, off-white and brown palette and the exact arrangement of his topknot, circlet, layered tunics, dhoti, belt, shawl and sword.
